spec2def(sfc_os.dll sfc_os.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# sfc_os.dll is all Rust (sfc_os-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/sfc_os-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# sfc_os.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/sfc_os-rust/src/sfc_os/sfc_os.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(sfc_os_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.c)
target_link_libraries(sfc_os_shims PRIVATE libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
add_cargo_module(sfc_os sfc_os-cargo sfc_os.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE sfc_os-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS sfc_os_shims)
